faq.title: Stable Audio 3 FAQ
faq.description: Answers about prompts, credits, homepage generation, and AI music workflows.

items.question: What is Stable Audio 3?
items.answer: Stable Audio 3 is an AI audio model family for generating music and sound from prompts. This site focuses on songs, loops, background music, and playable drafts.

items.question: Can I use the generator on the homepage?
items.answer: Yes. The music generator is embedded directly on the homepage so you can write prompts and start generation without opening a separate page.

items.question: How should I write prompts?
items.answer: A strong prompt includes genre, mood, BPM, instruments, structure, use case, and sonic texture, such as warm lo-fi, 90 BPM, soft drums, night city atmosphere.

items.question: Does it use site credits?
items.answer: The website uses site credits to control generation access. Real model calls can also require Stability platform API credits depending on your provider setup.

items.question: What is Free Test Audio?
items.answer: Free Test Audio is a local test mode for validating sign-in, credits, task records, player, and download behavior before spending model credits.

items.question: Can I connect a self-hosted service later?
items.answer: Yes. The provider structure can connect Stability API, Replicate-style services, or a private Mac mini inference endpoint later.
